integrity: A self-contained proof and exact-arithmetic script are embedded. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Theorems concern the last newly visited vertex in unweighted complete bipartite random walks. The exact law is finite; the logistic limit requires a near-balanced integer size sequence, and the balanced finite-sample comparison does not extend as claimed to all unequal parts. The standalone checker is finite. The known coupon-collector Gumbel theorem and the Myers-Wilf equal-time tie formula are established prior ingredients. Full-text access to the 1993 cover-tour priority paper was unavailable; earlier implicit coverage remains possible.
title: Exact endpoint probabilities and a logistic critical window for complete bipartite cover tours
